basic_info.description: Forget the hassle of renovations! This top floor spacious, designer-led two-bedroom, two-bath condo has just been completely renovated and is ready for you to move in and start enjoying a modern lifestyle. Step inside to find a light and inviting atmosphere, enhanced by light oak wood floors that flow throughout the space. The wood-burning fireplace adds warmth to the living area, perfect for relaxation or entertaining on those cold foggy nights. The kitchen is a chef's delight, featuring a stylish combination of oak and black cabinets, under-counter lighting, quartz countertops, and a sleek backsplash. Equipped with stainless steel Samsung appliances, this kitchen is as functional as it is beautiful. This condo features two full bathrooms with oak vanities, quartz counters, designer tile, and premium Hansgrohe fixtures, creating a spa-like retreat right at home. The new closet fittings maximize storage in the bedrooms and hallway, ensuring you have plenty of space for everything you need. Natural light floods the condo, accentuated by skylights in the bathrooms, making the space feel airy and bright. With plenty of thoughtfully designed living space, this unit offers both comfort and style. Additional perks include one car garage parking, storage and on-site laundry.
